name: Helping Hand (Major)
text:
This miniature wooden hand has fully articulated fingers with brass joints. The tiny hand twitches infrequently of its own accord, especially if scrutinized for too long.
- Armor You increase your maximum and encumbered Bulk limit by 3.

- Weapon You gain a +2 item bonus to skill checks to Aid when wielding the weapon.

Effect: Helping Hand - Armor

Effect: Helping Hand - Weapon
